snippet.title: New Game GDC 2023 Teaser Trailer - Fae & Fauna!
snippet.description:
Fae & Fauna is an open world pet collecting role-playing game. Collect magical creatures in undiscovered lands and fight with your companions against the dangers lurking in the wilds!

Wishlist us on Steam to follow development:
Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2363200/Fae__Fauna/
More info on our webpage: https://www.auroraartsstudio.com/
